name: @ours.network/messenger-server
description: Self-hosted messenger application for one identity on a shared ours daemon, with REST/SSE API, focused web client, and WebPush.
author: Adapt Toolkit

scripts.test:mobile-webkit: MOBILE_BROWSER_ENGINES=webkit node tests/browser-mobile-layout-webkit.test.mjs && HTML_BROWSER_ENGINE=webkit node --import tsx tests/browser-html-preview.test.mjs
scripts.test:mobile-webkit-ci: if [ "${CI:-}" = "true" ]; then npx playwright install --with-deps webkit && npm run test:mobile-webkit; else echo 'WebKit gate runs in CI (host dependencies unavailable locally)'; fi
scripts.test:offline: for f in tests/typed-commands-core.test.mjs tests/shared-daemon-contract.test.mjs tests/room-envelope-matrix.test.mjs tests/bundle-smoke.test.mjs tests/build-metadata.test.mjs tests/production-security.test.mjs tests/conversation-page.test.mjs tests/media-response.test.mjs tests/html-preview-transform.test.mjs tests/html-preview-response.test.mjs tests/push-store.test.mjs tests/push-store-hardening.test.mjs tests/push-browser-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/sw-push.test.mjs tests/push-delivery.test.mjs tests/events.test.mjs tests/watch-reconcile.test.mjs tests/introduction-send-guard.test.mjs tests/sse-e2e.test.mjs tests/presence.test.mjs tests/static-hosting.test.mjs tests/pwa-contract.test.mjs tests/update-check.test.mjs tests/web-contract.test.mjs web/tests/api.test.ts web/tests/events.test.ts web/tests/presence.test.ts web/tests/router-store.test.ts web/tests/components.test.tsx web/tests/markdown.test.tsx web/tests/voice.test.ts web/tests/read-gate.test.ts web/tests/receipt-presentation.test.ts web/tests/voice-duration.test.ts web/tests/voice-waveform.test.ts tests/room-preview.test.mjs web/tests/receipt-apply.test.ts; do echo "# $f"; node --import tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:loopback: for f in tests/shared-daemon-e2e.test.mjs tests/typed-command-loopback-e2e.test.mjs tests/introduction-send.test.mjs tests/rest-e2e.test.mjs; do echo "# $f"; node --import tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:browser: HTML_BROWSER_ENGINE=chromium node --import tsx tests/browser-html-preview.test.mjs && node tests/browser-room-envelope-matrix.test.mjs && node tests/browser-pwa.test.mjs && node tests/browser-accessibility-controls.test.mjs && node tests/browser-pointer-touch.test.mjs && node tests/browser-accessibility-preferences.test.mjs && node tests/browser-typography-foundation.test.mjs && node tests/browser-unread-positioning.test.mjs && node tests/browser-motion-material.test.mjs && node tests/browser-composer-focus.test.mjs && node tests/browser-typed-commands.test.mjs && node tests/browser-scroll-stability.test.mjs && node tests/browser-message-control-scroll.test.mjs && node tests/browser-mermaid-theme.test.mjs && node tests/browser-cold-open-sync.test.mjs && node --import tsx tests/browser-message-lists.test.mjs && node tests/browser-message-markdown.test.mjs && node tests/browser-voice-duration.test.mjs && node tests/browser-file-bubble-layout.test.mjs && node tests/browser-voice-waveform.test.mjs && node tests/browser-receipt-render.test.mjs && node tests/browser-receipt-converge-order.test.mjs && node tests/browser-media-panel-scroll.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:swipe && npm run test:timestamps && npm run test:mobile && npm run test:mobile-webkit-ci && npm run test:startup && npm run test:offline && npm run test:loopback && npm run test:browser
